text:
Type: wooden wall shelf with pegs
Use: displaying plates and cups, hanging towels, mugs or aprons; kitchen, dining room, hallway
Style: rustic, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: solid pine with a light antique stain, wooden peg rail, guard rails
Colors: warm honey pine, light amber
Shape: upright open wall rack with two slim shelves fronted by rails, a deeper bottom ledge with shaped side panels, row of round wooden pegs beneath, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, rustic, homely, warm
Goes with: white walls, stoneware, checked textiles, copper and wicker; farmhouse, country or rustic kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: GAMLEBY
product.description: The wall shelf makes it easy for you to see and reach the things you use every day.
